questions.prompt: According to your notes, put the immune response after vaccination in order.
steps: The vaccine introduces the antigen into the body
Antigen-presenting cells display the antigen to helper T cells
Helper T cells signal B cells to multiply
Some B and T cells remain as memory cells

Finally, some B and T cells remain as memory cells
